verdict.rationale: The evidence describes no built-in AI assistant inside the Brave Search API product, such as a dashboard or console agent that users can delegate tasks to. The AI Answers endpoint (including iterative deep research) and the LLM Context endpoint are API building blocks that developers call from their own apps. The MCP server and agent-platform guides cover integrations with external assistants, not an assistant shipped in the product, so none of these earn credit.
